name: Minakuchi Yuuza
source:
Sex: Male
Occupation: Apprentice Ama Diver
Age: 18 years old

A young man born and raised on Kameshima. Although generally quiet and serious, he has an eccentric side that often sees him make jokes and wisecracks with a straight face, catching whoever he's talking to off guard.
[spoiler]In truth, he died five years ago in the disaster that occurred off Kameshima and was resurrected by a mermaid, becoming an 800-year immortal.[/spoiler]
* * *
After losing his [url=/c164631]parents[/url] in the large-scale maritime accident five years ago, he was raised by his grandmother, veteran ama diver [url=/c164210]Tsuyu Minakuchi[/url]. He briefly found work at a seafood processing plant in Toba after graduating high school earlier in the year, but upon hearing that Tsuyu had injured her leg, forcing her to retire from diving and causing difficulties in her daily life, he quit his job after only three months and returned to Kameshima.
At present, he is caring for Tsuyu while looking for work on Kameshima, and he has recently made the decision to follow in Tsuyu's footsteps and become an ama diver himself. Although he has been unable to bring himself to enter the sea since the disaster five years ago, he is hoping that his previous aptitude for swimming will lend itself to a natural talent for ama diving. 
* * *
Quiet and introverted as a child, he began to show a more animated side upon befriending [url=/c163941]Azami Kumoi[/url], a boy his same age, and it eventually became a common sight to see them getting up to mischief together.
Although the maritime disaster five years ago saw a drastic shift in the way most of Kameshima's inhabitants treated Yuza, Azami alone continued to treat him the same. Even now, it is not uncommon for Azami to find himself caught up in Yuza's eccentric exploits, but he is always quick to laugh and follow his lead.

[From in-game profile]

[spoiler]His true age is 18, but his body remains that of a 13 year old boy.[/spoiler]
